generate_fairseq_manifests: generate Fairseq training manifests from a TSV file with audio file paths and frame counts
run_generate_manifests_cli: run the generate_manifests CLI tool with --stop_root and --output arguments to process train eval and test splits
get_insl_frame: convert a decoupled normalized seqlogical parse string into an INS frame format with bracket tokens
sequencify_utterance: convert a normalized utterance string into a space-separated character sequence with pipe delimiters
review_generate_manifests: review the generate_manifests module to understand how it processes audio NLP data for Fairseq training
